title: Unadmitted observation jobs and reports (runtime turns and source-root captures) are never pruned from the session row
outcome: Settled unadmitted observation reports and terminal closing jobs (runtime-started turns and explicit source-root captures) are pruned from the session record under a bounded retention rule, without losing a report whose delivery is still pending or uncertain, so the session row (re-read in full on each durability check) stops growing without limit.
acceptance: Unadmitted observation jobs and reports (runtime turns and source-root captures) are never pruned from the session row is done
